dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk Dear Elon Musk, 
What do you think will happen to Dogecoin?
@Investments_CEO I can't see your answer because Korea doesn't use Twitter much. After Elon Musk's SNL broadcast yesterday, the transaction amount of Dogecoin on the Upbit Exchange dropped sharply.
@elonmusk I won't bother you anymore if you buy Dogecoin in bulk for a moment and soar it to 700 Korean won.
